title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Remote After-Hours Amount
content:
**Ticket priced.** The ticket priced is the one whose resolution milestone (labor class remote after-hours, labor route invoice) is the latest by its resolution moment in the agreement's ticket history; the service desk platform never stamps two resolutions of one agreement with the same minute. Its resolution milestone supplies the recorded billable minutes. With no such ticket there is no labor to price and the amount is zero.

**Amount.** The after-hours remote amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket is the recorded billable minutes divided by 60, multiplied by the tier's remote hourly rate and by the tier's after-hours multiplier, rounded half up to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The values and the method used are fixed first; any percentage reductions are then added into one combined percentage, applied once, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).**

| Recorded billable minutes | Remote hourly rate | After-hours multiplier | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 90 | 100.00 | 1.5 | 90 divided by 60 is 1.5 hours, times 100.00 is 150.00, times 1.5 is 225.00 |
| 45 | 200.00 | 1.5 | 0.75 hours, 150.00, then 225.00 |
| 60 | 100.00 | 2.0 | 1 hour, 100.00, then 200.00 |
